Draft Response:

Baato drops to one knee under the rusted March Start Marker, gloved hands gripping the base where the metal meets the frozen earth. He braces his boots against the packed snow and heaves.

The marker doesn’t budge. The ice doesn’t crack. The wind just keeps howling through the hollow core like it’s laughing.

His shoulders burn. His fingers slip on the cold metal. He grunts and pushes again, veins standing out in his neck, but the post is anchored deep and the ground is rock-hard.

He lets go, breathing hard, and drops back onto his heels. His hands are raw, his forearms shaking.

QA Cinder Witness tilts her head. “You trying to move the border or just test how stubborn it is?”

QA Lantern Witness makes a small note in her book. “Attempt logged.”
